nphi.title: MPX-RESPONSE – Clinical research network to improve the management of mpox
nphi.with: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (Fiocruz); Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Fundación Huésped; Oslo University Hospital; ECRAID; UMC Utrecht; Erasmus MC; University of Antwerp; University of Verona; APHP; PANDEMIC platform
nphi.summary: Horizon Europe clinical research network studying mpox treatment and management, including trials and cohorts in Europe and Latin America, with Fiocruz and the Norwegian Institute of Public Health as participants.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – CLACSO MoU and 2026–2030 work plan on health, territory and climate
nphi.with: Latin American Council of Social Sciences (CLACSO, Buenos Aires)
nphi.summary: Fiocruz and the Latin American social science network CLACSO signed an MoU on 28 July 2026 with a joint 2026–2030 work plan. It covers territorial governance, climate and collective health, data sovereignty and open science across Latin…

nphi.title: ANLIS–PAHO technical cooperation agreement on vaccine development and production
nphi.with: Pan American Health Organization (PAHO); Sinergium Biotech; Agencia I+D+i
nphi.summary: Four-party technical cooperation agreement to strengthen capacity to develop and produce vaccines and health technologies in Argentina and the Americas, supporting the WHO mRNA technology-transfer hub.

nphi.title: Bio-Manguinhos–ANLIS yellow fever vaccine technology transfer
nphi.with: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán; Instituto Nacional de Enfermedades Virales Humanas Dr. Julio Maiztegui (INEVH)
nphi.summary: Term of commitment signed in Brasília in November 2023 for Fiocruz's Bio-Manguinhos to transfer yellow fever vaccine production technology to ANLIS, with manufacturing planned at the INEVH Maiztegui institute in Pergamino.

nphi.title: CDC South America Regional Office (SAMRO)
nphi.with: Brazil Ministry of Health – Secretariat of Health and Environmental Surveillance (General Coordination of Public Health Laboratories); Pará State Health Secretariat; Ecuador FETP
nphi.summary: Established in 2020 in Brasília, SAMRO supports surveillance modernisation, lab quality (SLIPTA/SLMTA with Brazil's lab network), FETP (Ecuador) and outbreak response (dengue, Oropouche, avian influenza) across South America.

nphi.title: REDSUR – South American Field Epidemiology Network
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia (coordinator); TEPHINET; national FETPs of member countries
nphi.summary: REDSUR, the South American network of FETPs created in 2011 with CDC support, is coordinated by Colombia's INS, which hosted CDC and TEPHINET to plan expansion of field epidemiologists across the region.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: Multicentric project on territorial health inequalities
nphi.summary: Fiocruz leads a US CDC-funded project on territorial health inequalities in five Latin American countries. IANPHI reports it under its Social and Public Health Inequalities Committee.

nphi.title: PAHO training on the new EIOS version for Argentina's epidemic intelligence
nphi.with: PAHO/WHO Health Emergency Information Management and Risk Assessment unit
nphi.summary: PAHO/WHO trained Argentine health-authority staff, including ANLIS Malbran's AI and data-science unit, on the new EIOS version in two in-person sessions (27-28 Nov 2025) and one virtual session (9 Dec 2025).

nphi.title: Multi-country study on quality of maternal health care for Indigenous women (Mexico, Argentina, Peru)
nphi.actor: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP) México
nphi.with: Research partners in Argentina and Peru
nphi.summary: INSP-led study with case studies in Mexico, Argentina and Peru on improving the quality of maternal health care for Indigenous women, listed in INSP's 2022 annual work plan.

nphi.title: IANPHI Latin America Network COVID-19 exchanges
nphi.with: ANLIS (Argentina); INLASA (Bolivia); CARPHA; INS Colombia; INCIENSA (Costa Rica); INSP Mexico; INS Peru; Guyana CMO; Uruguay MoH
nphi.summary: The Fiocruz-chaired Latin American NPHI network held bi-weekly virtual meetings in 2020 to share COVID-19 responses, serology, lab quality control and kit production.

nphi.title: CCASAnet – Caribbean, Central and South America network for HIV epidemiology
nphi.with: Clinical and research sites in seven countries
nphi.summary: NIAID-funded regional HIV epidemiology network coordinated by Vanderbilt with clinical research sites in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Haiti, Honduras, Mexico and Peru.

nphi.title: Argentina–PAHO–CARICOM triangular project on AMR detection and surveillance
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI
nphi.with: CARICOM Secretariat; PAHO/WHO; SENASA; Argentine Fund for International Cooperation (FO.AR); Best-dos Santos Public Health Laboratory (Barbados) and other CARICOM national laboratories
nphi.summary: Two-year FO.AR-funded triangular cooperation (2019–2021) in which Malbrán's INEI hosted internships and trained Caribbean laboratory technologists to strengthen clinical AMR diagnosis and surveillance in 14 CARICOM countries.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – ANLIS Malbrán memorandum of understanding
nphi.summary: Cooperation MoU between Brazil's Fiocruz and Argentina's national laboratories and health institutes administration ANLIS-Malbrán.

nphi.title: RINS/UNASUR – Network of National Institutes of Health of South America
nphi.with: ANLIS Malbrán; INLASA; ISP Chile; INS Colombia; INSPI Ecuador; LACIMET Paraguay; INS Peru; DLSP Uruguay; INH Rafael Rangel
nphi.summary: Network of ten South American national health institutes created in 2010 under the UNASUR Health Council, using structuring cooperation for exchange, training, institutional strengthening and joint projects, including joint work with…

nphi.title: Argentina Field Epidemiology Training Program
nphi.with: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación Argentina
nphi.summary: Argentina's FETP was launched with CDC support in 2010 within the national health ministry.

nphi.title: IANPHI/US CDC-funded AMR project at Argentina's Malbrán Institute
nphi.with: IANPHI US Office; US CDC (funder via cooperative agreement)
nphi.summary: Argentina's Malbrán Institute ran an antimicrobial-resistance project as one of the NPHI support projects funded by US CDC through IANPHI.
